fields.description:
Mirror inventory finding F5 (`reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md`), HIGH, ALREADY DRIFTED.
Distinct from the MCP-tool-vs-facade parity gate (`8ce5-b870-601d-4715`): that one is
tools-vs-facade, this one is models-vs-schemas. This is the PUBLISHED MCP wire contract.

(The inventory cites `schemas/check_mcp_models.py`; the real path is
`src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py`. Same file, prefix omitted.)

## Problem

`src/rebar/_mcp_models.py:1-24` declares itself a pydantic-only leaf with NO `rebar.*` import
edges, so every canonical enum is hand-copied into it:

- `:61-68` `PinStatus` (6 values) vs `llm/plan_review/pin_health.py:21`
- `:54` `TargetPinStatus` (4) vs `pin_health.py:29` — and a THIRD copy as dict keys at `:193`
- `:122` `FileImpactScope` vs `types.py:22`
- `:284-295`, `:298`, `:336` vs `schemas/bridge_{run,status,access_check}.schema.json`

The drift gate that is supposed to catch this has two gaps, both verified:

**1. It is enum-blind.** `missing_declarations` is exactly
`sorted(set(schema_properties) - set(model_fields) - set(permissive))` — a property-NAME set
difference. The string `enum` does not appear anywhere in the module, so a model and its schema
can advertise different allowed VALUES for the same property and the gate is silent.

**2. Its registry is hand-listed and 21 short.** `MODEL_SCHEMAS` registers 11 of the 32 public
`*Out` models. Of the 21 unregistered, **9 have a schema file sitting right there** under the
module's own `<snake_case>.schema.json` convention, so they could be checked today and are not:

    ClaimResultOut, ClarityResultOut, CreateResultOut, DepsGraphOut, GateResultOut,
    NextBatchOut, SearchResultOut, TicketStateOut, ValidateReportOut

`TicketStateOut` is the largest surface in the file. Both `PlanReviewHealthAvailableOut` and
`PlanReviewHealthUnavailableOut` — which carry the `PinStatus` copies — are absent entirely.
The remaining 12 unregistered models have no schema file and are correctly unregistered.

## Approach — add-parity-check on values, and derive the registry

1. **Enum parity.** Extend the check to compare each shared property's allowed VALUES, not only
   its name, reporting the offending property and the two value sets.
2. **Registry completeness.** Replace the hand-list with a derivation: every public `*Out` model
   whose `<snake_case>` name has a schema file MUST be checked. A model with no schema file stays
   out, and any deliberate exception is declared with a reason rather than omitted silently — the
   defect here was omission-by-forgetting, which a derived registry makes impossible.

**On epic AC2.** This does not merge distinct concepts: the models and the schemas already claim
to describe the same wire payloads, and the module's docstring states the copies exist only to
keep it import-free. Nothing about the enum values is intended to differ. The 12 schema-less
models are left alone precisely because they are NOT mirrors of anything.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: the gate compares enum VALUES for properties present on both sides, and fails when they
      differ. Verified by a test seeding a model/schema pair whose value sets diverge and asserting
      the failure names the property and both sets.
- [ ] AC2: the registry is derived, not hand-listed: every public `*Out` model with a matching
      schema file is checked. Verified by a test asserting the derived set covers all 9 models
      named above, which the current hand-list omits.
- [ ] AC3: a NEW `*Out` model with a schema file is picked up with no edit to the gate. Verified by
      a test that synthesises such a pair and asserts it is included.
- [ ] AC4: a model with no schema file is excluded without error, and any deliberate exception
      carries a stated reason. Verified by asserting the 12 schema-less models are absent and that
      the exception list (if any) is non-empty only where a reason string is present.
- [ ] AC5: every drift the widened gate now finds is either FIXED or recorded as a declared,
      reasoned exception — the gate must be green at rest, not merely more capable. Verified by the
      gate passing on the committed tree.
- [ ] AC6: the enum copies that started this (`PinStatus`, `TargetPinStatus` incl. the third copy
      at `:193`, `FileImpactScope`) are covered by AC1's comparison. Verified by naming them in the
      test so a future refactor cannot quietly drop them from coverage.

## Testing

- `python -m pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py -q` — the
  existing held-out suite plus the new enum-parity and registry-derivation cases (AC1-AC4, AC6).
- `python -m pytest tests/interfaces -q` — proves the widened gate is green at rest (AC5); it runs
  from a test rather than `make lint`, so this is where a regression would surface.
- `make lint && make typecheck`.
